manifest_row.title: California Report on Blackouts Blames Climate Change and Planning

screening.main_topic: California's 2020 rolling blackouts and the official report on their causes, including climate-driven heat, inadequate planning, and the electricity transition.
screening.climate_relevance: The report links increasingly common extreme heat to climate change and examines how planning for hotter weather and decarbonizing the electricity grid relate to power reliability.
screening.reason: Climate change and its impacts are a substantial part of the account of the blackouts, alongside energy-market and planning failures; the text also discusses the state's transition away from fossil fuels and efforts to decarbonize the grid.
